424B4 1 anthropicpbc-424b4.htm 424B4 Anthropic, PBC - 424(b)(4) Filed Pursuant to Rule 424(b)(4) Registration Nos. 333-299633 and 333-300148 Class A Common Stock 980,000,000 Shares Anthropic, PBC This is an initial public offering of shares of Class A common stock of Anthropic, PBC. We are selling 956,351,354 shares of Class A common stock and the selling stockholders identified in this prospectus are selling an additional 23,648,646 shares of Class A common stock. We will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares of our Class A common stock by any of the selling stockholders. Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. The initial public offering price per share is $83.00 . We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” We have a novel capital and corporate governance structure. We are incorporated as a public benefit corporation under Delaware law, a structure consistent with our commitment to artificial intelligence (“AI”) safety and responsibility. As a public benefit corporation, we are required to balance the pecuniary interests of our stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by our conduct, and the specific public benefit purpose identified in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation: the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.
